name: explainer-video
title: Explainer video
description: A short explainer video with synthesised sound rendered to an mp4 through the render_video tool - a scene script (title cards, numbers with their sources, schematic marks) and a sound cue list (bed, whoosh, chime, optional narration); every number on screen names its source.

tool.name: render_video
tool.runs_on: a remote runner with Manim or an HTML capture, numpy/scipy, ffmpeg loudnorm; the tool server forwards the call

blocked_on: SRV-105 (the tool server) and the remote runner. Until a chat offers a tool with `scenes` and `cues` arguments the tool fit leaves this package out and puts `explainer-video-script` in its place.
